name: ep0ch
description: ep0ch integration for Claude Code, following the outline the session folder is bound to: typed outline, workboard and door tools for agents (read, find, edit, comment, changes, draft.patch, ep0ch act), clickable references, and completed responses that mention [[pages]], ((block ids)) or Work IDs in the Outliner's Recent Mentions navigator, a copy of every message between Claude sessions under the outline's [[peer-messages]] page, and /msg to send one.

workspaces.title: Outliner folders (opt-outs, or the strict allowlist)
workspaces.description: Absolute folders, separated by ':' or ','. Sessions in them (and their subfolders) feed no outline, even when bound to one. In allowlist mode, instead only they feed (strict mode, as before folder mode). Empty: PI_OUTLINER_MENTIONS_WORKSPACES applies.

mode.title: How a session finds its outline
mode.description: folder: each session feeds the outline its folder's nearest .ep0ch names; a folder that names none feeds nothing, and listed folders are opted out. allowlist: only the listed folders feed, as before. Empty: PI_OUTLINER_MENTIONS_MODE applies; neither set: folder.

fileTouches.title: Switch off recording of edited files
fileTouches.description: off: nothing is recorded this session, whatever the outline's Recent files page asks. Otherwise the page's [file-touches::<glob>] properties decide. Empty: PI_OUTLINER_FILE_TOUCHES applies.

settle.title: The settle check (on, off, or the deployer's session)
settle.description: on: this session runs the settle check every 30 minutes (threads that go quiet wake it). off: never. Empty: EP0CH_SETTLE applies; neither set: only a session whose persona is loki.

settleOutlines.title: Outlines the settle check reads
settleOutlines.description: name[@ssh-name] separated by commas, such as gurgle@float-2, pie@float-2. Empty: EP0CH_SETTLE_OUTLINES applies; neither set: settle-outlines in the folder's .ep0ch/config.toml, else pie and gurgle on the session outline's machine.

settleTuning.title: Settle check thresholds
settleTuning.description: key=value pairs separated by ';': chirps=3; evan=1; quiet=60 (minutes without a touch); within=4320 (minutes after which a quiet thread is dormant); every=30; wake-max=5; base, evan-query, shaped-query (queries in the views' grammar). Empty: EP0CH_SETTLE_TUNING applies.
